searchText: Yah i got that PM and immediately blocked. so very easy to see it’s a scammer <@!748786776625250405> Please keep conversations on topic and research focused. This Discord server isn't really the place to meme or troll. (not related to comment above, related to comments elsewhere). Ok sir. Sorry. https://discordapp.com/channels/595666850260713488/749160974506000444/753885525513076748 <@456226577798135808> I'm surprised no one has said `ECC easily reversible`. Perhaps too technical for Twitter? I actually had a dream last night where I "cracked" ECC (meaning, I figured out how to go the other direction and find a private key from a public key) and I didn't know what to do with that information. Should I steal some money and exit before anyone else figured it out, or should I do some kind of responsible disclosure? If I did responsible disclosure (prove to people it was possible but not specifics of how), how would I protect myself from the government agents that would certainly try to hunt me down and wrench me for the secret? This would be a great thriller I would watch it. Mr. Robot type movie perhaps? yeah... I wonder if the RSA guys had similar thoughts because they were actually the second to invent it; the first mathematician was a guy named Clifford Cocks https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RSA_(cryptosystem)#History but it was immediately classified another version of this would be kind of a primer-esque movie about physicists that make a working garage-based quantum computer Meaning the government knew about the backdoor and didn't tell anyone? meaning they understood the potential for what widespread and ubiquitous encryption could mean for global espionage and tried to keep it from public view until it was independently made public by the 3 mathematicians R, S, and A then it was too late > yeah... I wonder if the RSA guys had similar thoughts Oh, sorry. I thought you were talking about the people who "cracked" (not quite the right term here) RSA. (not actually a crack, just a bug in a very popular library IIRC) oh I was going to say, that'd be big news! Consensus > politics < decentralised = miners / devops should we have a #memes channel or nah I like memes too, but I think it's better to post it in discords like ethstaker, ethfinance, etc. A lot of people here hang out / lurk there, no point in duplication either
